4659-4875-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4659-4875-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2769-3259-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

512-2872-7704.easyPrerequisites: Doc Samson and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
512-2872-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Clever Conjurer and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-2872-7704.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Doc Samson's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

4381-4694-5330-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-5330-7306.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-3841--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding an additional {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1011-2728-6798-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-6798-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-6798-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 4.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

659-4381-4613-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-7730.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

3110-3532-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3110-3532-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-6351-6718-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Teval triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat.
2034-6351-6718-7654.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

1409-3129-3671.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve the Wily Goblin trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

725-1329-3652-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Ornithopter, adding {1}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Ornithopter, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

413-3661-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Shield Sphere from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Shield Sphere enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4659-5003-6671.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Magic Pot, adding {C}{C}.
When Magic Pot dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Magic Pot trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

719-3767-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-856-4321-6462.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
413-856-4321-6462.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Kheru Goldkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1170-4124-5334-5478-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1477-1575-4231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1477-1575-4231.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1965-5113-5220.description:
Cast Omarthis either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Omarthis on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

3277-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Izzet Chronarch.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Essence Flux to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

341-2034-3321-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Filigree Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Filigree Familiar dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Filigree Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Filigree Familiar trigger, causing you to draw Filigree Familiar.
Cast Filigree Familiar by paying {2}.
When Filigree Familiar enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

2034-4089-5011.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic, adding {C}{C}.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Repeat.

428-1060-3908-4983.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Sun-Crowned Hunters indestructible.
 You have a way to deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters.
428-1060-3908-4983.description:
Give Sun-Crowned Hunters indestructible by any method.
Deal damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Sun-Crowned Hunters, Ghyrson Starn, and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 2 damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Spark Double and Sun-Crowned Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Sun-Crowned Hunters trigger, dealing 3 damage to target opponent.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to Sun-Crowned Hunters, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Ghyrson Starn and Sun-Crowned Hunters trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

849-2034-3240-3537.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {C}{C}.
Nether Traitor dies, triggering Anax, crating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Activate Bog Initiate by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Satyr token, adding {C}{C}.
The Satyr dies, triggering Nether Traitor, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
